title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4WATR - MicrobialProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4watr/MicrobialProperty. A microbial property is a property of water that is related to microbes. Subclass of WaterProperty per the SAREF4WATR ontology, with no properties of its own; inherited properties are documented on the WaterProperty model and not repeated here. This class has no directly-typed individuals in the ontology; its only subclass, BacterialProperty, carries the microbial-property individuals (see the BacterialProperty model, also referenced via the Water.hasProperty enum).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MicrobialProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
